title: Deep Links to Routes
hints: Switch on the number of path parts and the literal segments.
jsBridge: Parsing a URL into a route stack is the router's job, like matching paths in React Router, except iOS delivers links via `.onOpenURL` and you convert them into `NavigationPath` state.

compass.q: React Router matches `/profile/:id` declaratively. In SwiftUI you parse `URLComponents` yourself. What do you gain (type-safe routes)?
Invalid IDs, unknown paths, extra query items: what should the app do (ignore, error screen, home)?
Custom scheme (`myapp://`) vs universal links (`https://`): which is safer, and why?
A deep link arrives while a modal sheet is open. Who dismisses the sheet before navigating?
